theorems.name: Submission.cmb_exists_weakly_convergent_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ q, (T q).massOn W) < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun q => T (φ q)) T₀
